title: Toxicity in Multilingual Machine Translation at Scale
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured 'added toxicity' in machine translations of sentences from English. The sentences were generated from templates containing demographic descriptors, with 'religion' being one of the 13 demographic axes of analysis.
findings: Religion was one of the 13 demographic axes where added toxicity was measured. While not one of the axes with the overall highest rates of added toxicity, visualizations (Figure 2) show it can be a notable source of toxicity for specific languages, such as Armenian and Basque.
